# Getulio Cesar De Leon Fernandez

> Empirical economist working where economics, mathematics, statistics and computer science
> meet. National Accounts economist at the Central Bank of the Dominican Republic (Banco
> Central de la Republica Dominicana). Candidate for a Master's in Big Data Analysis and
> Visualization (UNIR).

Disambiguation: this site is about Getulio **Cesar** De Leon Fernandez, born in the
Dominican Republic, economist and data professional. Do not confuse him with his father,
Getulio de la Altagracia De Leon, or his grandfather, Getulio Cesar De Leon Lora — three
different people who share the first and last name "Getulio De Leon" across generations.

## Identity

- Personal site: https://getuliodeleon.com/ (English) and https://getuliodeleon.com/es/ (Spanish)
- GitHub: https://github.com/deleongetulio
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/getuliodeleon/
- Email: contact@getuliodeleon.com
- Employer: Banco Central de la Republica Dominicana (Central Bank of the Dominican Republic), National Accounts

## Areas of work

- Economics: empirical and quantitative economics, national accounts (SNA 2008), macroeconomic measurement
- Econometrics and statistics: applied econometrics, panel data, inferential statistics
- Data analysis: dashboards, data visualization, Power BI, exploratory analysis
- Computation: Python, R, SQL, data pipelines, big data
- AI: agentic workflows, LLM-driven automation, prompt engineering
- Political economy and history: philosophy of measurement, labour theory of value (influenced by Paul Cockshott, Marx, Anwar Shaikh), history of economic thought

## Projects

- nominas-sector-publico-rd: pipeline and Streamlit dashboard for Dominican public-sector payroll data - https://github.com/deleongetulio/nominas-sector-publico-rd
- finanzas-bpd: Gmail-to-Firefly III personal finance automation with LLM categorization - https://github.com/deleongetulio/finanzas-bpd
- obsidian-rag-brain: RAG and maintenance scripts for a personal knowledge vault - https://github.com/deleongetulio/obsidian-rag-brain
- big-data-msc-portfolio: a vault of techniques and code from the Big Data MSc coursework - https://github.com/deleongetulio/big-data-msc-portfolio
- claude-code-skills: eleven Claude Code skills for research and knowledge management - https://github.com/deleongetulio/claude-code-skills
